description_en: Summarizes cost information by instance or billable item
description_zh: 按实例或者计费项统计费用信息
kebab_example: aliyun maxcompute sum-bills --project-names projectName --start-date 1715393576201 --end-date 1776232895313 --stats-type PROJECT --topn 5 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SumBills

parameters.description_en: A list of instance names. This parameter is not required if `statsType` is set to `FEE_ITEM`.
parameters.description_zh: 实例名称列表，如果statsType是FEE_ITEM的时候，则projectNames列表不用传
parameters.help_en: A list of instance names. This parameter is not required if `statsType` is set to `FEE_ITEM`
parameters.help_zh: 实例名称列表，如果statsType是FEE_ITEM的时候，则projectNames列表不用传
parameters.name: project_names

parameters.description_en: The start time of the billing cycle.

parameters.help_en: The start time of the billing cycle
parameters.help_zh: 费用统计周期开始时间
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.description_en: The dimension by which to summarize costs. Valid values: `PROJECT` (by instance) and `FEE_ITEM` (by billable item).
